one_line: AI alliances split globally, while Google, education, and funding moves reshape the industry.

themes.title: US and China lead AI blocs
themes.text: The United States and China are each forming AI alliances, forcing other nations to choose between the two blocs.

stories.headline: Countries split as US and China create competing AI blocs

themes.title: Google shifts search to AI
themes.text: Google’s AI Overviews and AI Mode now prioritize AI‑generated summaries, reducing traffic to publishers and paying only modest fees for content used in answers.

stories.headline: Google’s AI search overhaul reduces traffic and pays tiny fees to publishers

themes.title: India adds AI to school curriculum
themes.text: The NCERT introduced a 20‑hour module on computational thinking and AI for grades 9‑12, developed with IIT Madras and IIT Jodhpur.

stories.headline: NCERT releases 20-hour AI and computational thinking module for classes 9-12

themes.title: New AI funding rounds announced
themes.text: SpaceX secured $40 billion in GPU debt financing for AI compute services, while Unacademy founders launched a ₹700 crore AI and deep‑tech fund targeting early‑stage startups.

stories.headline: SpaceX secures $40 billion GPU debt financing, launches AI compute contracts
Unacademy founders launch ₹700 cr AI and deeptech fund Longshot Capital
